columns.name: OFFER_COMMIT_TERM_ID
columns.description: Unique row id of commitment term

columns.name: PROD_OFFER_TERM_ID
columns.description: Indicates the Id of product offering term to which commitment term is associated to

columns.name: EARLY_TERMINATION_OPTION
columns.description: Indicates if the term has an early termination option

columns.name: EARLY_TERMINATION_PENALTY
columns.description: Indicates if the term has an early termination penalty

columns.name: PENALTY_GRACE_PERIOD_APPL
columns.description: Indicates if a penalty grace period is applicable or not

columns.name: AUTO_RENEWAL
columns.description: Indicates if auto renewal is allowed or not

columns.name: SPECIFY_PENALTY_AS
columns.description: Indicates how the penalty is levied

columns.name: REDUCE_PENALTY
columns.description: Indicates if penalty is reducible or not

columns.name: GRACE_PERIOD_DURATION
columns.description: Indicates the grace period duration value

columns.name: GRACE_PERIOD_UNITS
columns.description: Indicates the grace period duration unit

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
